results.quote: There is a randomized algorithm that computes a minimum s-t cut of an undirected unweighted graph G. The algorithm always makes \widetilde{O}(n^{8/5}) cut queries to G and succeeds with high probability.

There is a deterministic two-player communication protocol that computes a minimum s-t cut of an undirected unweighted graph G. The protocol uses \widetilde{O}(n\nu^{4/7}) bits of communication where \nu denotes the value of G's minimum s-t cut, and always succeeds.
